summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Phase 4C consent-first client comfort profile demo harness. All 12 test scenarios passed successfully. The demo correctly implements consent-first flow, per-category visibility controls, booking-scoped projection with status and ownership gating, immediate and reversible consent withdrawal, and enforces the 280-character visit note cap. Language rules verified: no medical terminology found, uses 'matches your preferences' copy throughout.
passed_tests: Page loads without red-screen errors, demo banner with 'fixture data only' and 'nothing persists' badges visible
Client view and Provider view panes both visible
CONSENT-FIRST: editors locked before consent (locked note visible, save button disabled)
Provider pane shows dark note mentioning consent and 'server: 404' before consent
Grant consent → editors unlock (locked note disappears, save button enabled, withdraw button appears)

Select preferences (pressure=light, sensitivity=sensitive_skin, visit note) and toggle visibility (comfort ON, sensitivities ON, visitNote OFF) → save → provider card shows ONLY Comfort and Sensitivities sections
Visit note NOT visible in provider card when visibility toggle is OFF
Provider card contains 'matches your preferences' language
PER-CATEGORY VISIBILITY: toggle visitNote ON → visit note appears in provider card with correct text
BOOKING STATUS GATING: card hidden when status='requested' (inactive), visible when status='confirmed' (active)
BOOKING STATUS GATING: card visible when status='en_route' (active), hidden when status='completed' (inactive)
OWNERSHIP GATING: card hidden when provider doesn't own booking, visible when ownership restored
CONSENT WITHDRAWAL: card disappears immediately, dark note mentions consent, withdrawn explainer visible in client pane
CONSENT RE-GRANT: card returns with previously saved data (no re-save needed), data persisted through withdrawal
LOAD SAMPLE FIXTURE: editor prefills with sample data, provider card shows Comfort + Accessibility sections only (per sample visibility)
Sample fixture: booking reason, communication, and visit note do NOT appear in provider card (correct per sample visibility flags)
DELETE PROFILE: provider card disappears, dark note shows 'nothing saved', editor resets to 'unspecified' values
LANGUAGE RULE: no forbidden medical phrases found ('medically suitable', 'safe for your condition', 'recommended for your health', 'diagnos', 'treatment for')
LANGUAGE RULE: page uses 'matches your preferences' language throughout
VISIT NOTE CAP: 280 character limit enforced (attempted 300 chars, capped at 280)

success_percentage.backend: N/A (no backend for this demo - fixture data only by design)
